demos.heading: Before you run anything: set up the shell
demos.purpose: DocuMind can answer a tenant's questions from four stores: its own Vector Search index (the ANN tier), the Firestore rung beneath it, or two managed mirrors, Vertex AI RAG Engine and Vertex AI Search. make up pins acme to RAG Engine and zeta to Vertex AI Search so every store the course teaches is exercised. A managed store holds the text of every current version, but not the kit's addresses: its citations come back with ids like acme:acme_497809ff...#rag-532341da71fe, a page of null even for a PDF, and stages.retrieval_backend: rag_engine. This lesson is about the kit's own rows, so point acme at them for the duration and put the pin back at the end. Module 2 compares the four stores; Module 7 studies the mirrors.

steps.manual_checkpoint: In the deployed UI's Chat page, signed in as yourself, set Brain to langgraph and ask: After how many years of continuous service is gratuity payable? When the answer is in, ask: Is it payable to a contract employee? Type done to read your thread back from the checkpointer: without the two questions there is no thread, and every later step of this lesson has nothing to read.

demos.heading: A turn cut off mid-flight, resumed from its checkpoint
demos.purpose: Do it: the cut-off turn, resumed At step 0 the first turn had not yet called the model, and the file recorded everything after it, so there is something to compare. The replay re-runs the turn from there and compares what it produced with what the file recorded: each message's kind and the tools it asked for, the sources each search returned, and the answer. A recording that stops mid-turn, like this thread's second turn, is compared as far as it goes, and the rest is what the replay added.

demos.heading: What the chat service does instead: a new question, and the repair
demos.purpose: Do it: the next question, offline The script above accepts any history. Gemini is the model your lane runs, so this cell asks it the same question on a copy of the cut-off thread, through the kit's LangGraph brain, with your lane's rag-api as documind-ui-sa: what /v1/chat would do. It prints the answer, or the error that would have been the request's 500, then the messages from the open call on, the calls left open and what the turn cost.
